arxiv-2104-04487.title: Language Model fusion for streaming end to end speech recognition
arxiv-2104-04487.description: Abstract Streaming processing of speech audio is required for many contemporary practical speech recognition tasks. Even with the large corpora of manually transcribed speech data available today, it is impossible for such corpora to cover adequately the long tail of linguistic content that’s important for tasks such as open-ended dictation and voice search.

arxiv-2209-15542.title: The worst approximable rational numbers
arxiv-2209-15542.creator: Boris Springborn
arxiv-2209-15542.description: Abstract We classify and enumerate all rational numbers with approximation constant at least 1 3 \frac{1}{3} using hyperbolic geometry. Rational numbers correspond to geodesics in the modular torus with both ends in the cusp, and the approximation constant measures how far they stay out of the cusp neighborhood in between.

arxiv-2310-14689.title: Feasibility of extracting the proton weak charge from quantum-control measurements of atomic parity violation on the 2 ​ s − 3 ​ s 2s-3s or 2 ​ s − 4 ​ s 2s-4s transition in hydrogen
arxiv-2310-14689.creator: Jiguang Li (李冀光), Andrei Derevianko, D. S. Elliott
arxiv-2310-14689.description: Abstract We explore the feasibility of extracting electroweak observables from a measurement of atomic parity violation in hydrogen. Our proposed quantum-control scheme focuses on the 2 ​ s − 3 ​ s 2s-3s or 2 ​ s − 4 ​ s 2s-4s transitions in hydrogen.

arxiv-2402-14210.title: Inclined junctions in monolayer graphene: A gateway toward tailoring valley polarization of Dirac fermions
arxiv-2402-14210.creator: Shrushti Tapar, Bhaskaran Muralidharan
arxiv-2402-14210.description: Abstract Generating discernible valley contrasts and segregating valley-indexed fermions in real space within graphene poses considerable challenges due to the isotropic transport within the continuum energy range for degenerate valleys. This study unveils an interesting finding: introducing valley contrast through anisotropic chiral transport in isotropic Dirac systems like graphene, achieved by implementing a tilted PN junction.

arxiv-2503-14315.title: Equiripple MIMO Beampattern Synthesis using Chebyshev Approximation
arxiv-2503-14315.creator: David A. Hague, David G. Felton
arxiv-2503-14315.description: Abstract This letter presents a method for synthesizing equiripple MIMO transmit beampatterns using Chebyshev approximation. The MIMO beampattern is represented as a non-negative real-valued trigonometric polynomial where the ℓ th \ell^{\text{th}} order polynomial coefficient is the sum of the ℓ th \ell^{\text{th}} order diagonal of the waveform correlation matrix.

arxiv-2512-00316.title: Finite-Sample Valid Rank Confidence Sets for a Broad Class of Statistical and Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2512-00316.creator: Onrina Chandra, and Min-ge Xie
arxiv-2512-00316.description: Abstract Ranking populations such as institutions based on certain characteristics is often of interest, and these ranks are typically estimated using samples drawn from the populations. Due to sample randomness, it is important to quantify the uncertainty associated with the estimated ranks. This becomes crucial when latent characteristics are poorly separated and where many rank estimates may be incorrectly ordered.

arxiv-2602-23104.title: Analytic Expressions for Shielded Halbach Multipoles
arxiv-2602-23104.creator: Volker Ziemann
arxiv-2602-23104.description: Abstract We employ the method of images to derive analytic expressions for the magnetic field of Halbach multipoles that are enclosed in high-permeability shielding. 1 Introduction Permanent magnets provide strong magnetic fields without using power supplies. This makes them very popular in in today’s energy-conscious world striving for sustainability.

pmc-10555047.title: THU458 Demineralization Zebras: A Rare Case Of Hypophosphatasia In An Adult Presenting With Osteopenia
pmc-10555047.creator: Bhanvi Prakash Ramchandani, Aysha Khan, Hassaan Aftab
pmc-10555047.description: Disclosure: B.P. Ramchandani: None. A. Khan: None. H. Aftab: None. Introduction: Hypophosphatasia (HPP) is a rare genetic bone disease with only 500-600 cases reported in the United States. It is characterized by mutations in the tissue non-specific alkaline phosphatase (TNSALP) gene, leading to impaired bone mineralization. HPP presenting in the perinatal period is fatal.

pmc-11404252.title: Pretransplant cardiac stress testing and transplant wait time in kidney transplantation candidates
pmc-11404252.creator: Ming-Sum Lee, Columbus Batiste, James Onwuzurike, Rachid Elkoustaf, Yi-Lin Wu, Wansu Chen, Joseph Kahwaji, Amandeep Sahota, Roland L Lee
pmc-11404252.description: ObjectiveRoutine screening for cardiovascular disease before kidney transplantation remains controversial. This study aims to compare cardiac testing rates in patients with end-stage renal disease, referred and not referred for transplantation, and assess the impact of testing on transplant wait times.

pmc-12491132.title: Comprehensive bioinformatics evaluation uncovers the possible oncogenic contribution of acrylamide to endometrial cancer
pmc-12491132.creator: Yiting Zou, Shan Lu, Shiqiang Han, Renfeng Zhao
pmc-12491132.description: BackgroundEndometrial cancer (EC) is a prevalent gynecological malignancy with increasing incidence worldwide. Despite advancements in treatment, challenges such as tumor recurrence and chemoresistance persist. Acrylamide, a probable carcinogen formed in high-temperature cooked foods, has been associated with EC risk, but its oncogenic mechanisms remain underexplored.

pmc-12511395.title: Young extracellular vesicles restore burn-induced adipose tissue immunometabolic and mitochondrial function in older mice
pmc-12511395.creator: Ayesha Aijaz, Shayahati Bieerkehazhi, Navneet Kang, Lauar de Brito Monteiro, Sean Saladhna, Sara Faour, Bhavishya Challagundla, Graham Rix, Faraz Chogan, Marc G Jeschke
pmc-12511395.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The idea of blood as an elixir of youth led to the classical experiment of heterochronic parabiosis, which demonstrated that young blood could rejuvenate aged tissues in mice. Later, it was discovered that this rejuvenating capacity is due to the presence of circulating extracellular vesicles (EVs), which override deleterious signals from the aged environment via intercellular cues that promote tissue renewal. Aging is associated with alterations in the structure and cargo of EVs with diminished nucleic acid content.

pmc-12577405.title: Turkish adaptation of the student survey on writing nursing care plans: a validity and reliability study
pmc-12577405.creator: Kadriye Aldemir Atmaca, Hümeyra Hançer Tok, Ezgi Yildiz
pmc-12577405.description: BackgroundThe increasing complexity of healthcare requires nursing students to acquire both theoretical knowledge and practical skills. Nursing care plans are essential for developing clinical competence and bridging the gap between theory and practice. However, many student care plans remain incomplete or lack patient-centred outcomes, highlighting the need for valid tools to assess competence. Currently, no such instrument exists in Turkey.

pmc-12657231.title: Efficient and accurate search in petabase-scale sequence repositories
pmc-12657231.creator: Mikhail Karasikov, Harun Mustafa, Daniel Danciu, Oleksandr Kulkov, Marc Zimmermann, Christopher Barber, Gunnar Rätsch, André Kahles
pmc-12657231.description: The amount of biological sequencing data available in public repositories is growing rapidly, forming a critical resource for biomedicine. However, making these data efficiently and accurately full-text searchable remains challenging. Here we build on efficient data structures and algorithms for representing large sequence sets1–6.

pmc-12663470.title: Impact of common variants on brain gene expression from RNA to protein to schizophrenia risk
pmc-12663470.creator: Qiuman Liang, Yi Jiang, Annie W Shieh, Dan Zhou, Rui Chen, Feiran Wang, Meng Xu, Mingming Niu, Xusheng Wang, Dalila Pinto, Yue Wang, Lijun Cheng, Ramu Vadukapuram, Chunling Zhang, Kay Grennan, Gina Giase, Kevin P White, Junmin Peng, Bingshan Li, Chunyu Liu, Chao Chen, Sidney H Wang
pmc-12663470.description: Genetic variants influencing gene expression have been extensively studied at the transcriptional level. How these variants affect downstream processes remains unclear. We quantitated ribosome occupancy in prefrontal cortex samples from the BrainGVEX cohort and integrated these data with transcriptomic and proteomic profiles from the same individuals.

pmc-13145395.title: Long-term aerobic exercise enhances circulating exosomal miR-214-3p to promote endothelial progenitor cell-mediated repair of endothelial damage induced by obesity
pmc-13145395.creator: Junhao Huang, Peilun Li, Bing Shen, Huiwen Gao, Shen Wang, Pingyu Wang, Weiji Deng, Dongdong Gao, Min Hu
pmc-13145395.description: Highlights•Long-term aerobic exercise enhances the function of endothelial progenitor cells via upregulation of circulating exosomal miR-214-3p, thereby promoting the repair of endothelial dysfunction induced by obesity.•miR-214-3p promotes the function of endothelial progenitor cells directly, by activating COL1A2, and indirectly, through the PTEN-PI3K-Akt pathway.•The myocardium is an important source of the long-term aerobic exercise-induced increase in circulating exosomal miR-214-3p.

pmc-13350768.title: Machine learning models predicting extubation success in mechanically ventilated patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13350768.creator: Péter Bakos, Bence Szabó, Dávid Laczkó, Caner Turan, Shir Galin, Péter Hegyi, László Zubek, András Lovas, Zsolt Molnár
pmc-13350768.description: BackgroundOptimal timing of extubation in mechanically ventilated patients remains a major challenge in intensive care. Machine learning (ML) models have been increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making, yet their predictive performance and readiness for clinical application in extubation outcomes remain uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the predictive performance and clinical readiness of ML models for predicting extubation success.

pmc-13385115.title: Perceptual distortions in PredNet and quantification of top-down/bottom-up flow
pmc-13385115.creator: Hiroki Kojima, Keisuke Suzuki, Yuichi Yamashita
pmc-13385115.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Perceptual distortions are widely observed in various psychiatric diseases, including Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Recent Bayesian models of psychiatric disorders and learning disabilities propose a general theory grounded on the concept of “aberrant precision.” However, these models have yet to be used as phenomenological models for visual distortions because previous models usually only deal with a low-dimensional input with Laplace approximation. Such assumptions are necessary for precision to be well-defined; otherwise, the explanation based on aberrant precision was hardly applicable.

pmc-13625406.title: Specimen-specific distribution of multidrug-resistant organisms and its association with glycemic control in adults with diabetes: a retrospective clinical microbiology study in southern Taiwan
pmc-13625406.creator: Jung-Sheng Chen, Mei-Yin Chou, Siang-Ru Huang, Chien-Sen Liao
pmc-13625406.description: BackgroundPatients with diabetes mellitus are susceptible to bacterial infections and may be exposed to repeated or prolonged antimicrobial therapy, which can increase the risk of multidrug-resistant organism (MDRO)-positive cultures. However, the distribution of MDROs across different specimen types and the relationship between glycemic control and MDRO isolation remain insufficiently characterized in regional clinical microbiology settings.

pmc-13675810.title: A new three-layer metapopulation networks model coupling online-offline social interactions with epidemic spread
pmc-13675810.creator: Nan Chen, Liang’an Huo
pmc-13675810.description: The dissemination of epidemic-related information can effectively enhance public awareness of preventive measures and decrease infection risks. However, information dissemination through multiple channels, including both online and offline sources, and the dynamics of information dissemination across these channels are influenced by individual mobility.

pmc-13700497.title: Molecular characterization of antimalarial resistance and hrp2/3 deletions in Plasmodium falciparum strains from Mtwara, Tanzania (2021–2024)
pmc-13700497.creator: Piyathida Thapradit, Watcharee Pagornrat, Wanassanan Madmanee, Raweewan Sangsri, Kiattawee Choowongkomon, Salum Mshamu, Deus S Ishengoma, Arjen M Dondorp, Lorenz Von Seidlein, Mallika Imwong
pmc-13700497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMalaria remains a significant public health challenge in sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia, with Plasmodium falciparum responsible for the majority of infections and deaths, particularly among children aged < 5 years. In Tanzania, the widespread use of antimalarial drugs, such as sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine for preventive therapy and artemisinin-based combination therapies as first-line treatment, has prompted concerns about the emergence and spread of drug resistance. The prolonged use of these drugs may have influenced resistance patterns, varying over time.
